setup.intro: Enter your character here. You play on the Sheet and manage items in the Inventory.
setup.hintLevel: Get new levels with “Level Up” above. HP, proficiency, spell slots, abilities and features are filled in automatically.
setup.hintStart: Choose class and ability scores, then “Build Level 1” above. For a higher start, level up several times afterwards.
setup.skillHint: Tap to cycle: not proficient, proficient, Expertise.
setup.featsEmpty: These arrive with level-ups. Add your own feats or subclass features here.
setup.resEmpty: These arrive with level-ups, e.g. Rage, Bardic Inspiration, Second Wind.
setup.pactHint: Pact magic (Warlock) returns after a short rest.
setup.backupHint: Everything lives only in this browser, so save a backup file regularly. A single sheet can still be exported as text.
setup.importConfirm: Replaces the current character. Click again.
lu.subPick: You choose your subclass ({subs}). Its features are in the book; add them under “Setup”.
lu.subFeature: At level {n} you get a subclass feature. Look it up and add the text under “Setup”.
lu.firstHint: Enter CON under “Setup” first, it counts here. {s} saving throws will be marked as proficient.
lu.featPh: Name of the feat, e.g. War Caster
lu.asiNote: Maximum 20. Feats are in the Player’s Handbook, chapter 6.
lu.spellNote: Find new spells afterwards in the Wiki (filter “Spells” and your class) and add them with one click.
lu.errRoll: Please enter the rolled value or take the average.
lu.errFeat: Please enter the name of the feat.
lu.featText: Feat. Look up its effect and add it here.
lu.doneFeats: Level {n} reached: +{g} HP, new features are on the sheet.
toast.saveFailed: Saving failed. Is the portrait too large? Choose a smaller image.
toast.raceBonus: Racial bonus: {b}. Please add it to your ability scores.
toast.deadAt0: Damage at 0 HP at least equal to max HP: instant death.
toast.failAt0: Damage at 0 HP: one death save failure (two on a critical hit).
toast.massive: Remaining damage at least equal to max HP: instant death by the rules.
toast.short: Short rest: “short rest” abilities are back. To spend hit dice, mark the boxes and enter the result under “Heal”.
toast.shortPact: Short rest: “short rest” abilities and pact magic are back. To spend hit dice, mark the boxes and enter the result under “Heal”.
toast.long: Long rest: HP full, spell slots, features and all Hit Point Dice back ({n}).
toast.exhDown: Exhaustion lowered by 1 (only with food and drink).
toast.condStay: {s} stays active: conditions do not end with a rest, but when their cause ends.
toast.noSlot: No free slot of level {n} or higher.
toast.ritualHint: As a ritual it works without a slot (10 minutes longer).
toast.occupied: Occupied: {a} cannot go on “{s}”. Put it elsewhere first.
toast.twoHanded: Note: {a} is two-handed, but the off hand is occupied.
toast.badExport: That is not a valid export. Please paste the complete text.
toast.badExport2: That is not a valid export.
toast.unknownFormat: Format not recognized. Expected an export from this sheet.
toast.badImage: The image could not be opened. Try a JPG or PNG.
toast.tempNoStack: Temporary HP do not stack. The higher value stays.
toast.stable: Three successes: stable. Unconscious, but no more saves needed.
toast.noSlotFit: No fitting equipment slot. Set the slot in the selection box.
toast.maxAttune: At most three attuned items. End another attunement first.
toast.copied: Copied. Paste it under “Setup” on the other device.
toast.selected: Text is selected. Copy with Ctrl+C (Mac: Cmd+C).
toast.needImport: Paste the export text or load a file first.

tv.title: What can I do on my turn?
tv.intro: On your turn: one action, at most one bonus action (only if something grants one), movement up to your speed and one free object interaction. One reaction per round, also outside your turn.
tv.d.attack: {n} attack(s) with a weapon or unarmed. You can grapple or shove instead of one attack (Unarmed Strike). Throwing a weapon is an attack. Draw or stow one weapon with each attack.
tv.d.dash: Extra movement equal to your speed.
tv.d.disengage: Your movement this turn doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks.
tv.d.dodge: Until your next turn: attacks against you have disadvantage, Dexterity saves have advantage (not while Incapacitated or at speed 0).
tv.d.help: Help an ally with an ability check, or distract an enemy within 5 feet: an ally’s next attack against it has advantage.
tv.d.hide: Dexterity (Stealth) check DC 15 while heavily obscured or out of sight. On a success you are Invisible until found, you attack or make noise.
tv.d.influence: Persuade, deceive, intimidate or entertain a creature (Charisma, or Wisdom for animals).
tv.d.magic: Cast a spell with a casting time of an action, use a magic item or a magical feature.
tv.d.ready: Name a trigger and prepare an action or movement; you take it as a reaction. A readied spell needs concentration.
tv.d.search: Wisdom check to notice something (Perception, Insight, Medicine, Survival).
tv.d.study: Intelligence check to recall or work out something (Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, Religion).
tv.d.utilize: Use a nonmagical object that needs an action (force a door, tie a rope).
tv.potion: Drink a potion or give it to someone
tv.poison: Apply poison to a weapon or three pieces of ammunition
tv.poisonD: Lasts 1 minute or until it hits.
tv.offhand: Extra attack with the light off-hand weapon
tv.offhandD: After attacking with a light weapon; no ability modifier to its damage unless negative.
tv.offhandNick: Nick: the extra attack is part of the Attack action, your bonus action stays free.
tv.bonusNone: Nothing gives you a bonus action right now.
tv.bonusRule: Without a feature, spell or item that uses a bonus action there is no bonus action. If you cast a spell as a bonus action, you can’t cast another spell with a spell slot on the same turn.
tv.oppD: One melee attack when an enemy leaves your reach.
tv.speedD: Split it before, between and after attacks.
tv.jumpD: Long jump up to {l} with a 10-foot run-up (half standing), high jump {h}. Every meter costs movement.
tv.proneD: Dropping prone is free, standing costs half your speed.
tv.terrainD: Each meter costs one extra meter.
tv.objD: Open a door, pick something up, draw a weapon. Another one needs the Utilize action.
tv.clarify: 2024 rules: Shove and Grapple replace one attack of the Attack action, throwing is an attack, jumping is part of movement, potions are a bonus action, only one spell slot per turn.
tv.src: Summary of the 2024 rules, check the book if in doubt.
mast.label: Mastery: {n}
mast.full: You already chose {n} weapons with mastery.
mast.hint: Tap to choose this weapon’s mastery ({a} of {b}).
res.channelC24: Divine Spark or Turn Undead (DC = spell save DC) and subclass effects. One use returns on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.
res.channelP24: Divine Sense and oath effects (DC = spell save DC). One use returns on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.
res.divInt: Magic action: cast a Cleric spell of level 5 or lower without a spell slot or Material components.
res.smite: Cast Divine Smite once without a spell slot.
res.steed: Cast Find Steed once without a spell slot.
res.layOn24: Bonus Action: heal from the pool; 5 HP from the pool end Poisoned.
res.favored: Cast Hunter's Mark without a spell slot.
res.tireless: Magic action: 1d8 + Wisdom modifier Temporary Hit Points.
res.veil: Bonus Action: Invisible until the end of your next turn.
res.sub.flare24: Reaction: Disadvantage on an attack against a creature within 30 feet.
res.sub.corona: Magic action: 1 minute of sunlight, enemies in it have Disadvantage against fire and radiant spells.
res.sub.warPriest24: Bonus Action: one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike.
res.sub.gloriousDef: Reaction: Charisma modifier to AC against one attack, counterattack on a miss.
res.sub.dreadful: Once per turn: +2d6 Psychic damage on a weapon hit (2d8 from level 11).
res.sub.mistyW: Misty Step without a spell slot, one creature can come along.
res.sub.beguile: After an Enchantment or Illusion spell: target Charmed or Frightened (Wisdom save). More uses for Bardic Inspiration.
res.sub.majesty: Bonus Action: Command without a spell slot, every round for 1 minute. More uses for a level 3+ slot.
res.sub.unbreak: Bonus Action: for 1 minute the first hit each turn misses unless the attacker succeeds on a Charisma save.
dm.budgetNote: XP budget per DMG 2024: sum of monster XP, no multiplier for the number of monsters. Beyond High can be deadly for some characters.
res.rage24: Bonus Action: Resistance to Bludgeoning/Piercing/Slashing, +{n} damage on Strength attacks, Advantage on Strength. One use returns on a Short Rest.
res.wild24: Bonus Action: Beast form up to CR {cr}, Temporary HP equal to your Druid level. One use returns on a Short Rest.
res.secondWind24: Bonus Action: regain {d} HP. One use returns on a Short Rest.
res.indomitable24: Reroll a failed saving throw with +{n}.
res.focus: Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind, Stunning Strike; Martial Arts die {d}.
res.metabolism: On Initiative: regain all Focus Points and Monk level + Martial Arts die HP.
res.innate: Bonus Action, 1 minute: spell save DC +1, Advantage on spell attacks.
res.sorcRest: After a Short Rest regain up to {n} Sorcery Points.
res.cunning: 1-minute rite: regain half your Pact Magic slots.
res.cunningAll: 1-minute rite: regain all Pact Magic slots (Eldritch Master).
res.contact: Contact Other Plane without a spell slot, auto-succeed on its save.
res.signature: Once each: cast a signature spell at level 3 without a slot.
res.sub.intimidate: Bonus Action: enemies within 30 feet Frightened (Wisdom save). More uses for a use of Rage.
res.sub.godsDice: Bonus Action: roll any number of d12s and heal that much.
res.sub.zealous: Bonus Action: up to ten allies get Advantage on attacks and saves. More uses for Rage.
res.sub.rageGods: With Rage: 1 minute of flight, resistances, reaction saves allies from 0 HP.
res.sub.natural24: One circle spell without a slot; after a Short Rest regain slots totaling up to level {n}.
res.sub.moonStep: Bonus Action: teleport 30 feet, Advantage on the next attack.
res.sub.starMap: Guiding Bolt without a spell slot.
res.sub.omen: Reaction: add or subtract 1d6 from a D20 Test.
res.sub.psi: Psionic Energy Dice {d}. One returns on a Short Rest.
res.sub.mercyFlurry: Hand of Healing/Harm without Focus with Flurry of Blows.
res.sub.ultMercy: Magic action, 5 Focus: revive a creature dead for less than 24 hours.
res.sub.wholeness24: Bonus Action: Martial Arts die + Wisdom modifier HP.
res.sub.spellThief: Reaction: negate an enemy spell and use it for 8 hours.
res.sub.implosion: Magic action: teleport 120 feet, creatures near your old space take 3d10 Force and are pulled. More uses for 5 Sorcery Points.
res.sub.balance: Reaction: cancel Advantage and Disadvantage on a d20 roll.
res.sub.trance: Bonus Action, 1 minute: no Advantage against you, your d20s at least 10. More uses for 5 Sorcery Points.
res.sub.cavalcade: Magic action: heal 100 HP, repair, end spells of level 6 or lower. More uses for 7 Sorcery Points.
res.sub.wings: Bonus Action: 1 hour of 60-foot Fly Speed. More uses for 3 Sorcery Points.
res.sub.dragon: Summon Dragon without a spell slot.
res.sub.tides24: Advantage on one D20 Test; returns through wild magic.
res.sub.tamed: Choose one effect from the Wild Magic Surge table.
res.sub.feySteps: Misty Step without a spell slot, with an extra effect.
res.sub.beguileDef: Reaction: halve damage, attacker takes it as Psychic. More uses for a Pact slot.
res.sub.healLight: Pool of d6s; Bonus Action: heal with up to {n} dice.
res.sub.searing: Before a Death Save: regain half HP, enemies within 30 feet take 2d8 + CHA Radiant and are Blinded.
res.sub.luck24: Add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw.
res.sub.clairvoyant: Wisdom save: Disadvantage against you, Advantage for you. More uses for a Pact slot.
res.sub.thirdEye: Bonus Action: Darkvision 120 feet, read any language or See Invisibility.
res.sub.phantasmal: Summon Beast and Summon Fey once each without a slot (half HP).

wiz.skillFull: Your class gives no more skills.
wiz.gearHint: Class starting equipment (SRD 5.2): a package or gold only. Free picks like an instrument go into the inventory by hand.
wiz.gearDone: Class starting equipment taken. More via inventory or wiki (Buy).
wiz.gearBg: Background equipment comes with picking the background (package A or 50 GP).
wiz.missing: Still open: {n}. You can go on anyway and fill it in under Setup later.
wiz.ready: All set. Levelling to 1 sets HP, saving throws, features and spells.
wiz.range: With point buy each score is between 8 and 15.
turn.title: Your turn
turn.intro: Everything you can do on a turn. As soon as you do something the sheet keeps count; “New turn” frees everything again (automatically in a live room when it’s your turn).
turn.introOn: What you did is used. Your reaction comes back at the start of your next turn. Spells cast from the spell list count too.
turn.oneBonus: one per turn, only if something gives you one
turn.oneReact: one per round, also on others’ turns
turn.s.attack: {n} attack(s) per Attack action. Attacks come from the Attacks list above.
turn.s.shove: Replaces one attack: push a target (up to one size larger) 5 feet or knock it Prone. STR or DEX save against 8 + STR + proficiency.
turn.s.grapple: Replaces one attack: target is Grappled. STR or DEX save against 8 + STR + proficiency, needs a free hand.
turn.s.dash: Extra movement equal to your speed.
turn.s.disengage: Your movement doesn’t provoke Opportunity Attacks.
turn.s.dodge: Attacks against you have disadvantage, DEX saves have advantage.
turn.s.help: Help an ally or distract a foe (advantage).
turn.s.magic: A 1-action spell, magic item or magical feature.
turn.s.magicOwn: 1-action spells (casting from the spell list counts): {n}
turn.s.ready: Set a trigger, resolved as a reaction.
turn.s.study: Intelligence check to recall or identify.
turn.s.utilize: Use an object that needs an action.
turn.s.surge: One extra action this turn (not Magic).
turn.s.potion: Drink a potion or give it to someone in reach.
turn.s.standUp: Costs half your speed ({n}). Dropping prone is free.
turn.no.action: Your action is already used this turn.
turn.no.attacks: All attacks of this Attack action are used.
turn.no.bonus: Your bonus action is already used this turn.
turn.no.react: Your reaction is used; it comes back at the start of your next turn.
turn.no.objAction: Your free interaction is used; another one needs the Utilize action.
turn.no.move: Your movement doesn’t reach that far (Dash gives more).
turn.no.slotRule: You can expend only one spell slot per turn.
hub.searchPh: Search campaigns, characters, spells or items …
hub.welcomeTxt: In the tavern or at the table – your next adventure starts here.
hub.noNext: No date planned yet. Add one to a campaign.
hub.planNote: Dates live on this device. Once the day has passed, it no longer shows as the next session.
hub.planEmpty: No active campaign yet. Create one to plan sessions.
hub.backTitle: Back to the start page (campaigns, characters, rules)
camp.name: Name
camp.localNote: Campaigns live on this device and are part of the backup file.
camp.doneHint: Counts one session played and clears the date.
camp.emptyTxt: Create a campaign, assign your characters and plan the next game night.
camp.onlyArchived: Only archived campaigns. See them all under “My campaigns”.
hub.groupEmpty: No characters yet. Create one or import a sheet (JSON or PDF).
map.source: Interactive map of Faerûn by aidedd.org (map: Mike Schley). Loaded only here and only when online; your own markers are stored by aidedd.org in your browser, not in the sheet.
map.offline: No internet connection: the world map comes from aidedd.org and cannot be shown offline.
nav.hereNone: The DM has not set a location yet.
nav.hereNoneDm: No location set yet (Exploration or Chronicle).
nav.noCampHint: DM mode without a campaign: combat, loot and notebook work as before. Open one of your campaigns to bring room, overview and party together.
nav.partyOffline: Fellow players show up here once you are connected to the campaign room (Overview).
nav.plotHint: Keep quests and open questions as notes of type “Plot” in the Chronicle.
nav.explorePlayer: Descriptions, clues and pictures come from the DM as handouts. Your own notes go into the Chronicle.
nav.invHint: Weapons, armor and backpack belong to the character. This page is about shared loot and shopping.
nav.stashOffline: The DM keeps the party stash. It shows up once you are connected and the DM is online.
nav.shopHint: Items with a list price can be bought under Rules & Lore; the price is taken from your coins. Selling works in the inventory.
nav.chronHint: Your notes on this campaign: what happened, names, open questions. Only on this device and in the backup file.
camp.shareHint: Give the code to your players. They join from their start page under “Join a campaign”.
camp.roomHintDm: Players only see combat, turns, the party stash and your messages while the room is open.
camp.noRoomP: No room code yet. You get it from your DM (edit campaign).
gm.none: You are not running a campaign yet.
gm.intro: Prepare your campaigns here: create them, generate a room code and give it to your group. “Run” opens the campaign with all DM tools. Anyone with the code can join; there are no accounts.
join.title: Join a campaign
join.hint: You get the code from your DM. “Connect” shows you the campaign before you join.
join.noMeta: The DM does not have the campaign open right now. You can still join and rename it later.
spell.prepModeHint: Filled circle = prepared. Unprepared spells stay on the sheet and are only hidden.
fight.prepDm: Load an encounter or add enemies and players, enter initiative, then “Start combat”.
fight.initHint: Enter initiative on the left of each row; the order sorts itself.
fight.prepRoom: No combat running. As soon as the DM starts combat, round and order appear here.
fight.prepSolo: No combat running. Without a DM in the room you can start the count yourself.
inv.sort.name: by name
inv.pick: Tap an item to see its rules text, values and actions.
notes.scope: Personal notes of this character. A campaign chronicle and the DM notes are kept separately.
lb.toolsHint: Only you see this bar. Chapter, date and plans go to connected players; the location only by title, never with your note text.
lb.noChapter: The DM has not set a chapter yet.
lb.noChapterDm: No chapter yet. Enter it above.
lb.noTasks: No open tasks. Lines of your chronicle starting with “[ ]” show up here.
player.name: Your name (player)
player.hint: Applies to this device and all campaigns. The group sees it next to your character.
inst.legacy: This campaign still uses the shared state from before the separation: character and DM data are the same as in other older campaigns. The separate takeover follows only after your approval.
